title: Harga Rak Lain
genre: Malay chart pop-rap duet (Garam & Madu lane)
subject: a customer and a hypermarket cashier arguing in rhyme when a pack of biscuits scans at RM12.90 but the shelf tag says RM8.90, while the queue behind them takes sides
caption: Malay chart pop-rap duet, bouncy radio pop-rap. Plucked synth bass, a clap-and-snap drum loop, bright piano stabs on the offbeat, a clean electric guitar riff in the hook. Punchy radio mix with dry vocals up front. Male rapper with a relaxed conversational flow trading lines with a female pop singer on the hook. 96 BPM, F minor. Bickering, playful and bouncy. No autotune, no heavy trap 808 slides, no EDM drop, no ballad strings, no dangdut.
lyrics:
[Intro - piano stabs and claps]

[Verse 1 - Male Rap]
Biskut coklat, satu paket
Tanda rak, lapan sembilan puluh
Kak juruwang imbas, bunyi bip
Dua belas sembilan puluh, eh tunggu

[Pre-Chorus]
Saya kata, jom pergi tengok
Dia kata, barisan dah panjang

[Chorus - Duet]
Harga rak lain, harga kaunter lain
Siapa yang betul, kita main tarik tali
Pakcik belakang angkat tangan
Saya nak harga rak, kak

[Verse 2 - Female Vocal]
Kak juruwang panggil supervisor
Supervisor jalan lambat sangat
Makcik belakang pegang kubis
Dia kata, adik ni betul la

[Chorus - Duet]
Harga rak lain, harga kaunter lain
Supervisor datang, garu kepala
Tanda harga minggu lepas
Dapat lapan sembilan puluh, ha

[Outro - guitar riff and claps, both laugh]
